gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Gugi is a bold display face with tall lowercase and open-cut terminals, drawn in one uniform outline. Noto Sans Palmyrene brings modern, clean sans curves that stop short of closing, which is the pair's real charm.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Gugi brings a bold display look with tall lowercase and open-cut terminals, none of it showing any brush-style swell. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau reads easily over a long page.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa reads contemporary and approachable, with openings you can see through and a gentle step up to capitals. Gugi earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Gugi stands up bold, its tall lowercase and constant-width lines nearly matching its capitals in height. Noto Sans Phoenician follows in plain sans, with wide-open s curves that give the page room beneath the heading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahlavi: Distinctive is the first word for Gugi, whose tall lowercase and perfectly round o keep one wall thickness throughout. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi supplies the strongest quality here: gaping e mouths and barely rising capitals that feel approachable.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang reads professional and contemporary, its lowercase counters wide as glass portholes with clear gaps in each curve. Gugi leads with distinctive, bold display letters whose steady unshaded outline is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-runic: Neutral, modern letters make up the body. Noto Sans Runic has a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves, so long text would move along freely beneath Gugi's bold, constant-width display lines.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan is approachable and professional, with plenty of daylight inside its curves and a hefty lowercase. Its size is the one to adjust, while Gugi stays as drawn.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Clean and neutral sums up the body. Noto Sans Sundanese keeps tidy e crossbars and a small gap from x-height to capitals, which sits nicely under Gugi's bold, fixed-nib display letters.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Approachable, clean letters carry the text here. Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves daylight in its curves, while Gugi earns its keep when set big and brief, each glyph drawn with one simple tip.
